title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 19
paragraphs: The region to the east of these agricultural Scythians, once one has crossed the river Panticapes, is occupied by nomadic Scythians, who neither sow anything nor plough the earth; and the whole of this region is bare of trees except for Hylaia. These nomads occupy a country extending to the river Gerros, a distance of fourteen days' journey eastwards.
